paragraphs: Rav Menashya son of R. Yirmeyah of Difti and Rabbah bar Shumnei: this is Ein Yaakov's reading. The Gemara has 'of Gifti' and 'R. Abba bar Shumnei.' They were taking leave of one another and said, 'Let each of us say something his colleague has not heard,' for Rav Mari son of Rav Huna said, etc., Eruvin 64a.
